records.text: Jessica Ghawi was present at a Toronto mass shooting and died in another mass shooting a few weeks later.
records.speaker: Baron Coleman

appearances.snippet: Jessica Ghawi was in that food court. she paid her bill at like i don't remember 6 20 or something like that and three minutes later the shooting started but in those three minutes she said she had a really weird feeling in her stomach decided she didn't want to be around and she walked out and i thought that's weird um she has this premonition that something bad's going to happen then a mall gets shot up And then a few weeks later, she dies in a mass shooting.

verification.notes: Jessica Ghawi's own contemporaneous account and the Congressional Record establish that she left Toronto's Eaton Centre shortly before the June 2012 shooting and was killed in the Aurora theater shooting the following month.

sources.title: Late Night Thoughts on the Eaton Center Shooting — Jessica Redfield
sources.relevance: Ghawi's contemporaneous first-person account says she left the Eaton Centre food court moments before the Toronto shooting.

sources.title: Congressional Record, July 26, 2012
sources.relevance: Records Ghawi's escape from the Toronto shooting and her death in the Aurora theater shooting weeks later.

records.text: Jessica Ghawi was shot six times in the Aurora theater shooting, which had 12 victims including an unborn child.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And she was shot six times. ... So this theater, we're told this guy just went crazy or whatever. This woman got shot six times, ... 12 victims in total, including an unborn child.

verification.notes: The Colorado court record states that Jessica Ghawi sustained six gunshot wounds. Official accounts count 12 people killed in the theater; an unborn child lost after the shooting was not included in that official victim total, so the compound claim is only partly correct.

sources.title: Probable Cause Order, People v. Holmes — Colorado Judicial Branch
sources.relevance: Official court findings state that Jessica Ghawi sustained six gunshot wounds.

sources.title: Century 16 Theater Shooting After Action Report — City of Aurora
sources.relevance: Official after-action report uses the recognized count of 12 fatalities, which does not add an unborn child to that total.

records.text: Jessica Ghawi had lived in New Braunfels, Texas.
records.speaker: Baron Coleman

appearances.snippet: she used to live in New Braunfels Texas of all places

verification.notes: Transcript context says Jessica Ghawi had lived in New Braunfels. Reliable biographies place her in the San Antonio area and later Denver, but current public records reviewed do not establish New Braunfels residence specifically.

records.text: Two police officers removed Jessica Ghawi from the theater in a police car and took her to a hospital.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: two police officers go into the theater and they pull her into a police car and personally say that they take her to a hospital.

verification.notes: The Colorado Judicial Branch probable-cause order states that one officer transported Jessica Ghawi from the theater in a patrol car while another officer rode in the back with her, and that they took her to University Hospital.

sources.title: Probable Cause Order, People v. Holmes — Colorado Judicial Branch
sources.relevance: States that two officers transported Ghawi by patrol car to University Hospital, one driving and one attending her in the rear.

records.text: Jessica Ghawi was omitted from her father's obituary.
records.speaker: Baron Coleman

appearances.snippet: when her father passed, she was not mentioned in his obituary. His daughter who was tragically murdered not terribly long before he died was not mentioned in his obituary.

verification.notes: Nick Ghawi's published 2024 obituary lists his surviving children and other family but does not mention Jessica Ghawi, confirming the narrow claim that she was omitted.

sources.title: Nick Ghawi Obituary (1944–2024) — San Antonio Express-News
sources.relevance: The published obituary lists family members but omits Jessica Ghawi.
